ticker_news.title: CMR Surgical secures 510(k) clearance of its Versius Plus robotic surgical system
ticker_news.description: CMR Surgical received FDA 510(k) clearance for its second-generation Versius Plus robotic surgical system, enabling cholecystectomy procedures and paving the way for US commercial launch in 2026.
ticker_news.author: Cmr Surgical

ticker_news.title: AI Chips Can’t Exist Without These 2 Underrated Tech Giants
ticker_news.description: The article highlights Applied Materials and Lam Research as critical infrastructure providers for AI chip manufacturing, explaining their essential role in creating advanced semiconductor technologies despite geopolitical challenges.
ticker_news.author: Jeffrey Neal Johnson

ticker_news.title: Nvidia vs AMD: Which AI Chipmaker Will Lead the Next Decade of Compute?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia remains the leading AI chip designer with a comprehensive ecosystem, but AMD is rapidly gaining ground in the AI chip market, offering competitive products and attracting significant customer interest.
ticker_news.author: Adria Cimino

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Vs. Alphabet: Which Could Be The World's Biggest Company By End-2026?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia and Alphabet are competing to become the world's largest company by end-2026, with both having a 35% probability of achieving this milestone. Their competition centers around AI dominance, with Nvidia leading in GPU technology and Alphabet embedding AI across its product ecosystem.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

ticker_news.title: Is Meta Stock Primed for a Comeback in 2026?
ticker_news.description: Meta Platforms showed strong Q3 growth with 26% revenue increase, leveraging AI to improve user engagement. Despite concerns about massive capital expenditure plans for 2026, the company is positioned for potential recovery, with stock trading at a reasonable 21.5 times 2026 earnings.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury
